posts.title: 30+ Black Women & Gender Diverse Community Leaders Over 65
posts.description: I’ve been working on this list of 30+ Black women and gender diverse community leaders who are over 65. With the passing of local African Nova Scotian activist Eddie Carvery and Rev. Jesse Jackson it seems important to share rather than waiting. Don’t wait to give people their flowers. Everyone on this list is still alive […]

posts.title: Autobiography: Redacted – Studies After Howardena Pindell
posts.description: “All the whiteness was getting on my nerves.” — Howardena Pindell on why she made “Free, White and 21.” (1980), New York Times, 2025 Howardena Pindell is almost 83 years old and still making art in her New York studio. posts.title: 2025 JFREJ Virtual Mazals Producer & Diasporspritz
posts.description: Project: Virtual producer of the 2025 Jews for Racial and Economic Justie (JFREJ) Mazals responsible for virtual run of show, coordinating with special guests, and event facilitation. Designed Diasporspritz printable and marketing content for JFREJ newsletter. Also virtual emcee of the 2024 Virtual Mazals program. Date: September 2025
